notes.title: New DLC items & Version Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellows!

We are excited to announce the release of our latest DLC: Souls of Chronos - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34991/Souls_of_Chronos__Pray_of_the_Stars_bundle/]Pray of the Stars bundle[/url]. 

This DLC is designed to alleviate the burden of grinding and material farming for new players, allowing them to easily enjoy the adventurous story of Sid and Tori in Astra!

In addition, we have also launched a version update that includes the following:

- Increased difficulty in the final battle, with upgraded skills for the Divine Thunder and Osiris!
 
Divine Thunder:
- Refined Thunder's power to release it three times instead of once, with lightning strikes now tracking the player's position.
- Enhanced Thunder's protection against elemental attacks, sealing the time-stop skill while the lightning chain is active.

Osiris:
- Unleashed the full potential of the Governor in spear form, allowing him to parry all frontal attacks.
- When Governor Sterling reaches 50% health in the second phase of his spear form, he enters an invincible state and summons lightning orbs in the arena, with small batfish joining the battle. The batfish will continue to respawn as long as the orbs remain unbroken. The orbs can be destroyed by attacking them, and once all are destroyed, Governor Sterling's invincibility state ends.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude for all the support and encouragement you have given us throughout this journey. With this update, the content updates for Souls of Chronos will come to an end. We will now be fully focused on our next project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1323830/_/]Shanghai Summer[/url], and we hope to meet you all in the coming months!

Best regards from dev team!

Patch Notes - 1.5.228.1
Roadmap of future updates
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

It has been one week since the release of Souls of Chronos. During the week, we received lots of feedback and suggestions from our players and community members. We are glad to hear that you are enjoying the game, but we are also aware that there are some shortcomings in the current version of the game. Therefore, we would like to make an announcement regarding our future plans for further polishing and content updates of our game.

First and foremost, after thorough investigations and all-out efforts, we have fixed ~80% of the known issues, and the remaining ones have been mostly identified and will be fixed as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience and understanding in advance.

Furthermore, we will continue to polish and improve Souls of Chronos over the coming weeks, addressing any remaining issues and shortcomings in the current version. Here is a non-exhaustive list of the issues that we plan to address in future updates:

[list]
[*] Overhaul of the Navigation System
[/list]
[i]We recognize that the current navigation system, such as quest indicators (Main/Side) or NPC locations, can sometimes be unclear or very difficult to make sense of. As such, we plan to overhaul the Map system to make it more comprehensive and easier to use, so that it can better display important information such as quest objectives, NPCs, treasures, and upgrade materials.[/i]

[list]
[*] Optimization of the Save System 
[/list]
[i]In response to feedback from some players that the current save system is not user-friendly and the death penalty is too much, we would like to adjust the tutorial chapter at the beginning to introduce the “Save Point” mechanism earlier to players. We also have plans to make adjustments to the save system in combat areas, minimizing the replay process[/i]

[list]
[*] Optimization of Keyboard and Mouse Controls
[/list]

To better accommodate keyboard and mouse users, we plan to revamp the current keybindings, including redesigning item use to avoid conflicting key combinations (such as 'Alt') and choosing standardized keybindings commonly used in other PC games. Additionally, we will be eliminating the use of the scroll wheel for item selection. We also plan to support the remapping of keybindings as soon as possible to improve players' in-game experience.

[list]
[*] Improvements on the Usability of Melee Weapon
[/list]
[i]Due to the unintended steep learning curve of melee weapons, players who are fond of melee weapons have reported underwhelming experiences. To address this, we will be improving the power of melee weapons to enhance their usability. This will allow them to exhibit comparable survivability to ranged weapons and make them more versatile in different circumstances. Additionally, we plan to further buff some of the upgrade options of 'Pneumatic Device' so that it is no longer obsolete when used in conjunction with melee weapons. We aim to provide players who prefer melee combat with a satisfying combat experience.[/i]

[list]
[*] UI Revamp
[/list]
[i]We are aware that some aspects of the current UI can be improved for better functionality and aesthetics. We are in the process of re-designing certain UI elements to make them more intuitive and will continue to optimize fonts, layout, and other aspects to create an overall simpler and easier-to-read UI.[/i]


[list]
[*] Other Minor Improvements
[/list]
[i]- Borderless windowed mode
- New font for the main menu to improve legibility
- Buff to Torii's Floating Leaf-style
- Optimized combat mechanics
- Adjusted combat difficulties for late-game boss fights
- Optimized Character/NPC/Environment interactions
- Optimized stock availability for Black Market Vendor
- Ability to switch day/night without the need to visit a save point[/i]



In addition to the overall optimizations mentioned above, we are committed to providing future content updates. Our current plan includes the following:


[list]
[*] New Game+ Mode – ETA 2 - 3 Months
[/list]
[i]We are planning to introduce more playable characters, but we still want to ensure that the first playthrough experience remains undisrupted. Thus, we plan to implement and enable this feature in the second playthrough, after completing the story fully once. Players can choose to control certain characters in the game, while still retaining Sid and Torii as the main characters for dialogues and interactions to advance the story.[/i]

[list]
[*] Endless Combat Challenge: Snow Mountain Tower – ETA 2 - 3 Months
[/list]
[i]We are planning to introduce a new area, Snow Mountain Tower, for players to explore.
This area will be independent from the main storyline, and the focus will be on providing players with thrilling and satisfying combat encounters. And it is entirely possible to see a unique combat system here too! We hope you are as excited about it as we are and look forward to sharing more details with you soon![/i]

The above content updates will be released to everyone as soon as it's ready, and we'll carefully consider whether it will be free or paid. We'll keep you informed about our decision so please stay tuned!

Lastly, just want to let you all know that we truly value everyone's opinions and feedback. As a small, indie dev team, it is certainly not easy for us to make our games to perfection at the first swing. However, we are committed to doing our best to improve our game and make it more enjoyable to play, and we appreciate your support in this endeavour.


Sincerely,
The Development Team
February 23, 2023

notes.title: "Souls of Chronos" is set to release on February 14!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

It's been over a year since the first demo of Souls of Chronos was released on Steam, marking our RPG debut. Despite its imperfections, the demo received a tremendous amount of positive feedback and suggestions, and players fell in love with the post-apocalyptic world we created. These encouraging words fueled our passion to continually improve every aspect of the game, bringing our vision of Souls of Chronos to life.

Then, a successful crowdfunding campaign at MoDian brought in many "Founders of Astella" and led to the launch of a revamped demo in September 2022. As a group of young developers, we are overwhelmed by the increasing interest in Souls of Chronos and are deeply grateful for your continued support. Thank you!

Today, we are extremely happy to announce that Souls of Chronos is set to release on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC Steam globally on February 14th! Join Sid and Torii on their thrilling adventure as they explore Astella and beyond to eventually uncover its mysterious secrets!

The Background – A Post-Apocalyptic New World

Embark on an epic journey with Sid and Tori as they explore the diverse and perilous world of Astella. From the murky underground sewers to the hidden gang hideouts, to the breathtaking terrestrial coral and the peaceful Red Woods, every location presents unique challenges and opportunities. Choose to be bold or strategic, to align with a faction or strike out on your own. Join the Chronus and the Linked as they battle for their fate in a complex web of forces that threatens to shape the future of Astella and the entire continent.

The Combat – Forge Your Own Style: Customizable Weapons & Time-bending Chrono Power

As Sid’s partner, Torii will also join the combat and fight alongside him. As they level up, players can choose different skills to master different combat styles. Also, with the progression of the story, the pair will be able to unlock new mechanisms.
As a powerful Chronus, Torii can unleash her special Chrono power to manipulate the time during combat anytime when you are at a disadvantage to turn the tide. Sid, on the other hand, can choose two weapons to equip at the same time, from a total of six distinct weapon types, each with its own upgrade path – Find the combat style that best suits you and battle some of the most fearful foes!

The Characters – Friends from Astella

The world of Astella teems with diverse NPCs, each with their own unique backgrounds and personalities. We have worked tirelessly to bring these NPCs to life, revising their character designs to reflect their stories and the factions they represent. As you navigate this post-apocalyptic world, you will have the opportunity to forge powerful alliances and join forces with them against a looming storm that threatens to upend the fragile peace.

Of course, there is much more to it! We would like to thank you once again for your continued support. We would like to invite you to share your thoughts and suggestions with us. 

We hope you all enjoy Souls of Chronos.

Sincerely,
Futu Games & Astrolabe Games

notes.title: Demo Gone, Official Release Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Since the release of the Demo in September, we have received a lot of feedback and suggestions for our community members! We are extremely grateful for your continuous support and attention, and we have made quite some corresponding revisions based on all the feedback we collected over time.

However, because of this, the Demo currently available for download is now quite outdated and thus, cannot reflect the quality of the version we are preparing to release to everyone. Therefore, we have decided to temporarily take down the Demo before the official release.

YES, YOU HEAR IT RIGHT, we are now in the final leg before the official release! As for the official release date, please allow us to keep that a secret for now and we will announce it VERY SOON.

In the upcoming official release, we will bring you the adjustments to the following area in game:
[list]
[*] Combat System;
[*] Art and Assets;
[*] Soundtracks and SFX;
[*] and everyone's favourite - Balance;
[/list]

Additionally, we'd like to let you know that the official version will include a total of five chapters of the main storyline and four branching endings, based on the choices you made along the way.

We are doing our very best to ensure all of you can enjoy the fully-polished official release.

Thank you again for your attention and support, and we wish you a happy Chinese New Year! See you soon!

Your development and publishing team,
January 20th, 2023.

notes.title: "Souls of Chronos" Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

How do you like the announcement trailer for “Souls of Chronos”?

We are extremely pleased to let you know that the demo for “Souls of Chronos” is available, as of NOW!

We welcome you all to Astella, to experience the world of “Souls of Chronos“ via this demo. 

Here is a brief introduction of what is included in this demo.

-	Story & Characters

Although the demo only covers the beginning of the story we plan to tell, most of Sid's important friends and partners are already introduced. Of course, the conspiracy that drives the fate of Astella is yet to be revealed, as well as the masterminds behind the scene, a.k.a. “Team Bad Guys”.

-	Combat System

The demo includes a part of the very first dungeon in the game – Sewers. It features a variety of enemies that could bring trouble for our players in many ways. Don’t forget to challenge the demo-exclusive boss at the end!

-	Weapon System

There are a total of four weapons included in the demo. We are sure our players will be able to find their favourites!

-	Supplemental System

In the demo, a small portion of the cooking, alchemy, and weapon modification systems are accessible, offering players useful buffs and deadly weapon modifications to handle these fearful foes.

As this is the first public demo of “Souls of Chronos”, we would love to hear your thoughts and opinions about your experience, not only on the art and gameplay, but also on the localization of the game. You can always find us here on the discussion board. Alternatively, please do not hesitate to reach out to us on Twitter or Facebook. Feel free to check out our Discord channel too! Any input would be greatly appreciated!

Thank you so much for your attention, and for playing the demo of “Souls of Chronos”!

The Dev Team
Sep. 28, 2022

notes.title: 摩点众筹已开启啦~
notes.notes:
各位玩家朋友们，好久不见！

今天有一件大事宣布：[url=https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/117492.html]《时灵 星辰愚者》摩点众筹开始啦~[/url]

《时灵 星辰愚者》是一个我们酝酿了很久，也为之努力了很久的项目。她寄托了我们全体成员对JRPG的热爱，我们有一个很大的世界要创造，有很多故事想要讲述，本次将与大家见面的《时灵 星辰愚者》虽然只是其中很小的一部分，但却是非常非常重要的开端，对我们有着举足轻重的意义。

通过这次众筹，一方面当然是希望能够获得资金上的支持，但更重要的是希望获得来自广大玩家朋友们的支持，这也将成为我们前行的动力。我们也绝不会辜负大家的期待，将更加努力投入到未来的开发工作中去，为大家带来更完整，更有趣的作品！

我们近期也收到不少玩家询问正式发售日的消息，但由于目前的开发工作还存在着一些不确定因素，所以非常抱歉，暂时无法回答确切的发售时间。但请相信其实我们和大家一样，也无比期待着我们的游戏能够早日以令人满意的姿态与大家见面！

另外，由于最近版本调整和改动非常大，我们暂时下架了之前的旧demo，并且近期会提供一个最新的demo供大家试玩，具体时间会再发公告通知。
大家可以点个心愿单持续关注~
或者加入我们的玩家Q群：784316829

我们会努力让《时灵 星辰愚者》早日与大家见面！
祝大家中秋快乐！

开发团队敬上

notes.title: 《时灵：星辰愚者》21.12.31更新日志：
notes.notes:
玩法更新
-添加了全新的托莉玩法——休息与红莲气刃
在游戏制作中我们发现给予玩家对托莉行为的一定控制权，可以增加战斗中的游戏体验。现在，托莉的生命值不再自动回复，需要按下特定按键让托莉在激烈的战斗中获得喘息，以此来将托莉的作用最大化！
同时修改了托莉空血蹲防的机制。
-添加了全新的BOSS——巨鼠
通过探索，找到通往巨鼠巢穴的道路，并将其击败吧！
-添加了武器“赤纹炸弹”的全新强化
现在赤纹炸弹可以手动引爆了！并且还有两层的强化可供体验！
键鼠可以通过按下G键引爆，手柄刻通过R2键引爆。
-在剧情体验中增加了关于“时停”能力的QTE教程
-添加了新的“时停”玩法
现在在时停中可以击落飞行中的弩箭！

《时灵：星辰愚者》的试玩版已经在steam上线了！欢迎大家在steam搜索下载，如果喜欢的话还请添加愿望单，在taptap或者微博上持续关注我们的动态。

另外游戏的制作还在紧张地进行中，考虑到让玩家可以更好理解——当然还有更加帅气，将游戏从《时光编年史：阿斯特拉的萌芽》更名为《时灵：星辰愚者》。
